picks.title: 1816: Krishna, Vishnu and the Mystery of the Avatars
picks.summary: Most Vedic literature speaks from a perspective within this universe. But some reveal that this universe is just a tiny bubble among countless others — and invite us to view our place in existence from outside. Depending on which angle we look from, either Vishnu or Krishna will appear to be the origin of the Avatars. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that question alongside Akrūra's extraordinary vision in the Yamuna — seeing Vishnu in the water, coming out to find Krishna on the chariot, going back in and seeing Vishnu again. When I am seeing you, what have I not seen? Srimad Bhagavatam 10.39.
picks.reason: Discusses Vishnu, Krishna, and the nature of avatars with scriptural insight.

picks.showTitle: The Sadhguru Podcast - Of Mystics and Mistakes
picks.title: #1532 -  Pandit Dhirendra Shastri & Sadhguru
picks.summary:
Bageshwar Dham’s Peethadhishwar Pandit Dhirendra Shastri spent time in the consecrated spaces of Isha Yoga Center Coimbatore and met Sadhguru on 22 July. During a conversation with Sadhguru, he shared his experience of meditating in the powerful presence of Dhyanalinga and spending time in the abode of Linga Bhairavi adjacent to Isha Yoga Center. He explored a number of topics with Sadhguru including Santana Dharma, Yoga and meditation, how one can turn inward and whether one can progress on the spiritual path without the guidance of a live Guru.


Conscious Planet: ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠
picks.reason: Conversation on Santana Dharma, yoga, and meditation with Sadhguru and Pandit Dhirendra.

picks.title: Five Things I Apologize For
picks.summary: “Ishvara (the Supreme Lord), jiva (the living entity), prakriti (nature), eternal time and karma (activity) are all explained in the Bhagavad-gita. Out of these five, the Lord, the living entities, material nature and time are eternal.” (Shrila Prabhupada, Bhagavad-gita, Introduction)
picks.reason: Explains key Bhagavad-gita concepts like Ishvara, jiva, karma, and eternal time.

picks.title: 82. War Night 16 | Internal Sabotage by Shalya | Psychological War on Karna | Karna's 2 Curses
picks.summary: The night of the 16th day of Mahabharat War presents the Kaurava high command with a massive logistical and strategic crisis. To have any chance of defeating Arjun, Commander-in-Chief Karna requires a charioteer whose tactical genius matches that of Lord Krishna. Duryodhan identifies King Shalya of Madra as the only viable candidate. However, asking a royal, high-born monarch to drive the chariot of a man labeled a "Suta" (charioteer’s caste) is a monumental diplomatic insult. In a brilliant masterclass of political manipulation and ego management, Duryodhana frames the request not as a demoti
picks.reason: Analyzes Mahabharata war strategy and caste issues with ethical and psychological depth.

picks.title: The Mindset You Need for Meditation | Essence of the Geeta | Episode 83

picks.title: 📫  Remember Divinity in Every Duty
picks.summary:
We're diving into the 70 essential episodes of the ultimate sacred text -- the Bhagavad Gita. Chapter 8, Verse 7 centers on the theme of intensification, where Shri Krishna teaches how to deepen our devotion. By remembering Divinity in every moment—including at the time of death—we evolve from faith to trust, rediscovering the Divine even amidst daily life.
➡️ This season, we are exploring the 70 essential verses of the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita. To maximize your experience of this season, we encourage you to request your FREE copy of the Essential Love eBook. Incorporating accessible translations
picks.reason: Explores Bhagavad Gita verse on remembering divinity in every duty and death.

picks.title: Gospel | Chapter 7: Dec 14, 1882 (Part 4) | Swami Sarvapriyananda
picks.summary: Swami Sarvapriyananda reads and discusses the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna. The Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna is an English translation of the Bengali spiritual text Sri Sri Ramakrishna Kathamrita by Swami Nikhilananda.
